reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis focuses on hardness/strength but does not address friction or wear mechanisms across the 25–800 °C range, and the proposed Ti addition and phase mix are not linked to tribological performance.
reasons.testability: The falsification test only checks hardness and phase fractions, not coefficient of friction or wear rate, so it cannot decide whether the intervention solves the stated tribological problem.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis ignores the core challenge of maintaining low friction and wear over the full temperature range, offering no mechanism for tribological improvement, so it is not useful for the research question.
